title: Geocode contract
description: Response shapes for forward geocoding (GeocodeResponse) and reverse geocoding (ReverseGeocodeResponse). Both mirror the `Suggestion` dataclass in `app/geocoding.py` field for field.

id.description: Provider feature id (empty when the provider has none).

type.description: Provider feature type (e.g. address, poi, place).

attribution.description: Attribution for the data this suggestion came from.

GeocodeResponse.title: GeocodeResponse
GeocodeResponse.description: Forward geocode response: query text to ranked suggestions.

ReverseGeocodeResponse.title: ReverseGeocodeResponse
ReverseGeocodeResponse.description: Reverse geocode response: coordinates to ranked suggestions.
